blocksize.description: The block size to consider for file starts. Usually set to the hardware sector size (e.g., 512) for best performance.

devices.description: A list of block devices or files to scan for recoverable files.

input_file_list.description: Path to a file containing additional device names to scan, one per line. Empty string means use command line devices only.

machine_readable_mode.description: The output mode for machine-readable stdout. Options are 'i', 'o', or 'io'. Empty string disables this mode.

output_directory.description: The directory where recovered files will be saved. Must have sufficient free space and not be on the source device.

recipes.description: A list of recipe names or paths to use for identifying file types. Examples: jpeg-jfif, png, gif.

resume_offset.description: Offset to resume scanning from. Can be absolute (=), relative (+), or from EOF (-). Supports hex (0x) and sign.
